question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which group do you want to see more of?
options: Older characters like Colt and Denni.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm nice, considerate, and thoughtful!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha ha! Like those matter when you're Social Chair!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're wrong. They're what matters most!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's the point of being Social Chair if the only person you're pleasing is yourself?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not the only one who enjoys my parties. And in the end, that's what it comes down to.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who's party is better?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Mine` is.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mine[/i][/color] is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is there anything else the, uh, spirits would like to tell me?
Madame Fortuna turns and stares into her crystal ball.
Suddenly, the crystal ball begins to glow softly, and $ZOE swears she can see faces swirling in its depths...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it--
Madame Fortuna's voice, slow and haunting, stops $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: He cares for you, the one you long to be with.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean Howard?
Madame Fortuna doesn't acknowledge $ZOE's words. She just repeats herself.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: He cares for you, the one you long to be with.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Do not be fooled, do not doubt it, do not hesitate to tell him what you know to be true...

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Or else it will be too late.
$ZOE nods at her words, spooked by her tone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won't.
She gets up from her chair and exits the tent.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What was that all about?
Madame Fortuna flips the card, and $ZOE can see the image of a large wheel turning.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: The Wheel of Fate turned upside down. Hmmmm...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: It means that a terrible tragedy awaits you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My luck's already bad tonight. It doesn't seem like it's doing much `waiting... `
nodes.text_bbcode: My luck's already bad tonight. It doesn't seem like it's doing much [color=#3b78e2][i]waiting... [/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you know what the tragedy is?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: I cannot see specifics. My powers only grant me a small glimpse of your future.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: However, the wheel of Fate constantly turns which means that though tragedy will befall you, eventually you will move on to experience a great victory.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great tragedy... Great victory...
Madame Fortuna flips it, and $ZOE can see the image of a crowned figure sitting triumphantly on top of a horse.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: It is the Crowned King.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: It means that luck is with you, and you will experience a great victory.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you know what kind of victory?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: I cannot see specifics. My powers only grant me a small glimpse of your future.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm kind of relieved to hear that...

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Hopefully that will ease your worries for the evening...

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: But be warned... Your victory will not come without its price.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So a great victory... But also a great tragedy?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: That is correct...
$ZOE struggles to come back with three reasons why she'd be a better Social Chair!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See? You can't even think of three reasons yourself!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Maybe it's because I'm nice?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Nice'?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Oh, I really want someone `nice` to be Social Chair'... Said no one ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Oh, I really want someone [color=#3b78e2][i]nice[/i][/color] to be Social Chair'... Said no one ever!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They want someone fun! Someone who throws great parties! Someone with a shred of sense!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And you don't have any of those things.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Go ahead. Spend as much time on my side of the gym as you want.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe you'll get why everyone thinks I'm better at this than you are!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They do not!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh really? Look around. Give me one good reason why people think `you'd` make a better Social Chair than `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? Look around. Give me one good reason why people think [color=#3b78e2][i]you'd[/i][/color] make a better Social Chair than [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll give you three!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is it `that` dead on your side of the gym?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is it [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] dead on your side of the gym?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That is `sad.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#3b78e2][i]sad.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I meant that I came over here to... Bore... Myself...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do lame people even know how lame they sound?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hungry?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, your entire carnival smells like food. I mean, the funnel cakes are awesome, but the corn dogs? It makes your entire side smell like day-old mustard.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can't possibly be trying to insult me for having `snacks` at my carnival.
nodes.text_bbcode: You can't possibly be trying to insult me for having [color=#3b78e2][i]snacks[/i][/color] at my carnival.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just saying that people aren't going to like that greasy smell lingering in their hair all night!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got, uh... I got... Bored?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No thanks. I'd like to explore the rest of the place.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, but we're going straight to your haunted house after this! I promise!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks.
$ZOE leaves, and Ben and Emily trade worried looks.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? Is this a telepathic couple thing that I won't understand?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I'm just worried about $ZOE's chances at Social Chair. If no one's on her side...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sure people will go over.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Maybe $ZOE should try to make her side more exclusive. That's what clubs do.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That... Doesn't make sense. How would excluding people attract more of them?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It doesn't make sense if you put it like that, but maybe... Oh, look... Hot guy!
Kimi quiets down as Cameron comes up to them, phone in hand. He puts an arm around Emily and Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: How about a picture, you two?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Um...
Emily glances uncertainly at Ben as Cameron snaps a photo. He examines the picture.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What's with the face, Em? Come on... You're a marauding pirate! And marauding pirates smile!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, marauding pirates eat cotton candy. Which is what we're doing now. Maybe you can go find other girls to take pictures with?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sure.
Cameron shrugs and walks off.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You didn't have to be mean to him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Was he or was he not flirting with you?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's hard to tell with Cameron...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: He wasn't! And we're friends, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: As fun as it is being in the middle of this... Our cotton candy's up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Forget it and move on?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah...
Meanwhile, $ZOE wanders further into the carnival that Paige has set up. She passes funnel cakes and corn dog stands, petting zoos, and circus performers.
She's so absorbed watching the booths in the carnival, she nearly runs over Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, watch where you're--
Paige notices $ZOE and smiles wide.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, well, well... If it isn't $ZOE! I'd know that terrible French pastry haircut and fake tan anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Paige.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Paige.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't care if Paige is winning right now, but I'm not going to let her get to me...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing on my side of the gym anyway?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what kind of cotton candy are you going to get?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Whatever flavor pink is. I love cotton candy...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's a good thing we don't have a cotton candy machine around school all the time, or else I'd always be eating it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Whatever. I bet you can eat anything you want, and you'd still look great.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Does this mean I should get you a cotton candy machine for Christmas? I've been saving up for your present...
Emily playfully shoves Ben. Ben notices that $ZOE isn't smiling.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... Cheer up. Paige may have some interesting snacks...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But our haunted house is phenomenal! Once people see it, they'll go nuts.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah! The cupcakes you baked for everyone in the haunted feast room are so delicious! And you put a lot of care into all the rooms.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sure everyone's making their way over to your house right now.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, guys. That does make me feel better.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Want to stay with us and get some cotton candy? And then we'll walk to your side together?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paige definitely knows how to throw a fun party.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh man, does she ever!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Did you `see` the pumpkin carving booth? It's `crazy!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]see[/i][/color] the pumpkin carving booth? It's [color=#3b78e2][i]crazy![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've thrown a ton of parties, but I don't think I've ever taken it to the level--
Emily clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Ahem.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahem.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Er... It's not as good as our haunted house, though.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I bet Paige didn't bake cupcakes or make attractions specifically for different groups...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It may look like she has a lot of stuff here... But yours has a lot of heart.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben...
$ZOE looks glumly at the ground.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, want to stay with us and get some cotton candy? And then we'll walk to your side together?
Howard begins to respond, but stops, distracted by something.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE. I know you're worried about that, but can we talk about it after I deal with something?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on?
Howard nods at a stage that's been built off to the side.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nicole is dancing on that... And not in a `clean` way.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nicole is dancing on that... And not in a [color=#e23b3b][i]clean[/i][/color] way.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Woo hoo!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah, Nicole! Shake what your grandma gave you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yikes. I see. You'd better get her down...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or else Ryan's going to slip in his own drool.
Howard turns from $ZOE and strides to the mess of the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Dancing like that is definitely not appropriate!
$ZOE turns back to her haunted house, but no one has come in since Sam left.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'd be nice if Howard weren't so busy. I could really use someone to talk to... What am I going to do now?
$ZOE looks over at the bright lights and colorful music of Paige's spooky carnival.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I should go check it out...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone else is...
$ZOE wanders onto Paige's side of the gym where tents and booths have been set up.
She is immediately greeted by the sight of rides and a boardwalk of carnival games.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She has a corn maze and a three-ring circus?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My side seems so weak by comparison...
$ZOE spots Ben, Emily, and Kimi waiting in line for cotton candy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahoy, I see a $ZOE... Arrrr!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nice costumes, guys. You make a very fine band of pirates.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I like your masquerade ball costume. It's like you're in an opera.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So what are you doing over here in enemy territory?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No one's come to the haunted house...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry... That must feel terrible.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We'll definitely go over to your haunted house... After we get our cotton candy.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know if I'll get any. I'm still feeling a little sick after the Caramel Apple Cauldron Paige set up near the mini-carousel.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She has a mini-carousel too?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh... Maybe she does.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's okay, guys...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Sam!` You scared me so much I practically forgot it was `my` haunted house!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam![/i][/color] You scared me so much I practically forgot it was [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] haunted house!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Yeah, I did! Did you `see` your face?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha ha! Yeah, I did! Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]see[/i][/color] your face?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I can't see my own face! And of course I was frightened! You swung an `axe` at me!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I can't see my own face! And of course I was frightened! You swung an [color=#3b78e2][i]axe[/i][/color] at me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Relax, it's foam. It would have just bounced off your forehead.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it was scary!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's a haunted house... You're supposed to be frightened.
Sam punches $ZOE in the shoulder. $ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll tell you what's frightening...
She points across the gym at Paige's haunted carnival, at all the people having fun, eating and playing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `That.` Everyone's having so much fun over there that they've forgotten about my haunted house!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That.[/i][/color] Everyone's having so much fun over there that they've forgotten about my haunted house!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How am I supposed to get votes for Social Chair when `no one` is here?
nodes.text_bbcode: How am I supposed to get votes for Social Chair when [color=#3b78e2][i]no one[/i][/color] is here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They haven't `forgotten`, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: They haven't [color=#3b78e2][i]forgotten[/i][/color], $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You think so? What if it's my haunted house? What if people hate how it looks?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No way! You worked so hard on it. You even came by the dance two hours early to add more stuff to it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You made a mad scientist's laboratory that the nerds will get a kick out of... Your graveyard cemetery is sure to be a hit with the cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The hipsters will love the artsiness of the scary feast... And anyone who likes to be scared, which is `everyone,` is going to love the scary monster at the end of the hall of mirrors...
nodes.text_bbcode: The hipsters will love the artsiness of the scary feast... And anyone who likes to be scared, which is [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone,[/i][/color] is going to love the scary monster at the end of the hall of mirrors...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam, but no one's going to see it if they don't go inside... At this point, I `want` there to be a ghost in my haunted house, just so `something's` there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks, Sam, but no one's going to see it if they don't go inside... At this point, I [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] there to be a ghost in my haunted house, just so [color=#3b78e2][i]something's[/i][/color] there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Try not to worry too much. There's a good reason no one's here yet. But they'll come over shortly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Looks like Howard's coming over. I'll leave you two alone. I'm going to the other side of the gym to check out Paige's carnival.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're abandoning me too, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's just to check out the competition. Besides, I heard she had fancy snacks. I'll steal some food for both of us.
Howard approaches as Sam heads off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. I managed to get five minutes away from the job. Being a chaperone is harder than it sounds!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is this your haunted house? I can't believe you and Ben made this in two hours! It looks spooky!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad you think so. It seems to have scared everyone else away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's still early. People will come.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what's it like being a 'Parent Chaperone'?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not as much fun as I was led to believe. I have punch duty later, and twice, I've had to tackle a freshman for `inappropriate` dancing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not as much fun as I was led to believe. I have punch duty later, and twice, I've had to tackle a freshman for [color=#e23b3b][i]inappropriate[/i][/color] dancing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But if it lets me come to a dance with you, then it's the best job in the world.
He leans down to kiss her. When he pulls away, the look on her face makes him frown.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm worried...

options.label: About you transferring to Centerscore U.
That I won't win Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Ahhhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ahhhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: She screams for a full minute before she realizes nothing else has happened.
Instead, Sam stands there, axe in hand, doubled over laughing.
$ZOE ducks!
The axe swings straight over her head!
$ZOE is about to scream for help when she sees Sam, axe in hand, doubled over laughing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha... Nice... Reflexes.
$ZOE doesn't know what to do! She freezes in place and lets out a terrifying scream!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The fortune teller did say that the Wheel of Fate turns... Maybe this is what she meant.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's looking great! Everyone's inside, and they're having a great time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which is probably why they voted you for Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, about that... It seems weird that all voted for me. I'm still confused why I won and not Paige...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel like I didn't even do anything to deserve it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, you did. Like I said, you and Ben spent a ton of time making this haunted house special for everyone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: People really appreciate that. It makes everyone here think of you as a friend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But they didn't even come over to my side of the gym until the very end...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that's because a ton of them went over to Paige's side to get snacks before they ran out. You know how excited everyone gets around free food...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But once everyone got what they wanted, they came right on over. See? Everyone likes you! You just scored a `great victory!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But once everyone got what they wanted, they came right on over. See? Everyone likes you! You just scored a [color=#3b78e2][i]great victory![/i][/color]

nodes.text: For a moment, Paige is stunned... Then she glares at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paige, I'm sorry--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No. This just proves that no one is `that` nice. Deep down, you're just as mean as all the other popular girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. This just proves that no one is [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] nice. Deep down, you're just as mean as all the other popular girls.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't think you're any different.
Paige storms off just as Sam comes up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was a little harsh, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean to say that. She made me snap. Please don't lecture me. I'm embarrassed enough.
Sam shrugs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how's the haunted house?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lucky?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... For most of the evening, I thought I didn't stand a chance.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I feel lucky that I have so many good friends who are willing to vote for me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, you `nice` girls are all the same. So insipid.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, you [color=#3b78e2][i]nice[/i][/color] girls are all the same. So insipid.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I hope you `enjoy` being Social Chair. May all your dances be total disasters.
nodes.text_bbcode: I hope you [color=#3b78e2][i]enjoy[/i][/color] being Social Chair. May all your dances be total disasters.

nodes.text: Paige storms off as Sam comes up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Was she congratulating you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: More like kind of the opposite.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, how's the haunted house?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's because... Uh, it's because...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, you can't finish a sentence! How did you win?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because no one likes you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good bye, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good bye, $ZOE.
$ZOE runs inside, sparing one last look back to see Howard, handsome as ever in his tuxedo and mask, turn away from her for the last time.
$ZOE slips back into the gym where Taylor is standing on stage with a microphone.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hello, everyone! Even though Social Chair is a relatively new position, it's still an important one.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The best Social Chair is not necessarily the person who throws the best parties, but rather the person who is able to pull the school together as a whole.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Without further ado... You all voted, and now it's time to hear who wins!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Your Social Chair for this upcoming year is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Go, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yay, $ZOE! Woo hoo!
$ZOE rubs at her eyes one more time and adjusts her mask. She joins Taylor up on the front stoop of her haunted house.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And here she is... Your new Social Chair!
The entire gym bursts into enthusiastic applause!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you, everyone! I'm so happy that you voted for me. I promise that this year is going to be so much fun!
Everyone claps as $ZOE steps down. Paige storms up to her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So how did you do it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do what?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't bat your mascara-laden eyelashes at me. I `know` you did something dirty to win. Everyone was on `my` side of the gym for most of the evening!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't bat your mascara-laden eyelashes at me. I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] you did something dirty to win. Everyone was on [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] side of the gym for most of the evening!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How could they go with you?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't `cheat`, if that's what you mean.
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]cheat[/i][/color], if that's what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So how did you do it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe it's because...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what I'll do without you either.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What happens when you can't go back to how you used to be?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You move on, I guess.
Then $ZOE corrects herself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What we `had` was special. A once in a lifetime thing.
nodes.text_bbcode: What we [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] was special. A once in a lifetime thing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes, it was. And I'll never forget it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The fortune teller did predict a great tragedy...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You should be out there having fun being Social Chair, hanging out with Sam and your cheerleading team, maybe even dating someone who's still in high school...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, don't date anyone. I'm okay with that too.
$ZOE laughs despite the hole in her chest.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then this is the part where we say our good-byes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you'll wish me well, and I'll wish you well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then... And then we forget about each other.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm never going to forget you, $ZOE. Never.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But the more time I spend here, the more I'm certain that being together isn't good for either of us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. It's... It's just never been so hard for us before.
$ZOE sighs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want this to happen. I refuse.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't accept what you're saying right now. I can't even believe it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It makes me so angry!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't even want to fight for us? Are you too afraid to even try?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I did try, $ZOE. I came back for you. I was willing to give a lot up for you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not afraid, $ZOE. I'm certain.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The more time I spend here, the more I'm certain that being together isn't good for either of us.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't matter if I win or lose tonight. I'm just really glad I have good friends like you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Speaking of which...
He points at the gate, and $ZOE sees Ben, Emily, and Sam coming in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, guys... Welcome back. It's still pretty quiet around here...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not for long! There's a whole bunch of people behind us! They're headed for your house right now!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Looks like everyone just went over to Paige's for the food... Now that it's gone, they want to see you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's wonderful!
She smiles winningly at Owen who mouths 'I told you so'.
A few minutes later, $ZOE's haunted house is swarming with people!
Students fall in line to visit the haunted house, while others dance in the graveyard!
In one corner...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Did you `see` the Mad Scientist's lab? It has the most fascinating scientific experiments!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you [color=#e23b3b][i]see[/i][/color] the Mad Scientist's lab? It has the most fascinating scientific experiments!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nope! I was too busy stuffing my face with $ZOE's awesome cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: This is really a horrific masterpiece.
While in another...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Spencer, I can't believe you guys really got the gargoyle!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Believe it, man! Ghosts chased us out of that cabin!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Is it going to curse me? Is it?
And out on the dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm dancing on a headstone! Look at me! I'm dancing on a headstone!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's go in again... We can make out in that spooky hall of mirrors!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, I think that gargoyle is staring at me funny...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This house is `spooky!` Great job, $ZOE!
nodes.text_bbcode: This house is [color=#3b78e2][i]spooky![/i][/color] Great job, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
At that moment, someone taps $ZOE on her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard! I'm so glad you're here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was having the worst time, and I couldn't find you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I think everything's going to work out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm happy for you... But do you think we can get a moment to talk?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, sure...
$ZOE looks to her haunted house. She catches Sam's eye and points to Howard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go have your moment. Ben and I will take care of things here!
Howard takes her hand, and they walk outside.
Outside in the cool night air...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad you finally got some time off! I didn't think I was ever going to get to see you...
$ZOE trails off when she sees the grim look on Howard's face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE... I think...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think we should break up.
$ZOE feels as though she's been punched in the gut.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why? What changed in the last hour?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I had a run-in with Nate...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no. What did he say?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A bunch of stuff that pissed me off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But also some things that made me think about what I was doing and why we were getting back together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't really belong in your world.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, that's not true. If you're talking about high school... Everyone still remembers and loves you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's true that I still have friends here, but... I don't feel like it's where I'm supposed to be.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, I can't even spend time with you at a dance! And that meant not being able to be by your side when you needed me the most.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But things worked out.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Only because you have good friends like Owen. He did what I couldn't.
Howard looks down. Then he takes both of $ZOE's hands.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I love you so much, and I don't regret any of the time we had together.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I think I was wrong to come back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... You weren't. You wanted us to be together. You thought we were meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And maybe we are. But not right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So this is it then?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're really good at cheering me up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm glad. You know that I'll always be here for you, right?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know.
And in that moment, $ZOE suddenly feels warm, content, and safe...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We used to be such good friends. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, we haven't really had the chance to talk ever since...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ever since?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ever since Howard came back. You've been... Busy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Right. I guess it was kind of my fault we got out of touch...
And in that moment, $ZOE suddenly feels guilty for not spending as much time with Owen...
You are now playing as $ZOE.
Meanwhile, $ZOE sits in front of her house with Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You didn't have to come and sit with me, you know.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, I'm just happy I get to talk to you. Of course, I hope you don't mind my saying that it seems pretty `dead` around here.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I'm just happy I get to talk to you. Of course, I hope you don't mind my saying that it seems pretty [color=#e23b3b][i]dead[/i][/color] around here.

nodes.text: $ZOE groans.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you think of that just now, or were you waiting all evening to say that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just something I thought of in the moment.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Awful.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Would it help if I said that `I want to suck your blood?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Would it help if I said that [color=#e23b3b][i]I want to suck your blood?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha. I like my blood where it is, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Then how about we just sit and talk?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Owen... This entire night's a mess. Everyone is on Paige's side of the gym. I don't think I have a shot at winning Social Chair now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The night's not over yet. You shouldn't give up. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're an amazing person. You're always nice to people, and you're always there for your friends.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, you helped me pull my life together. I can't be the first person you've helped. And people don't forget that kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen...

options.label: That makes me feel a lot better.

nodes.text: He resists the urge to hit Nate, forcing his hands down by his side.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A Kingston King wouldn't hit a high school kid. Even a punk high school kid who's asking for it.
Howard turns away from him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Where are you going? You're not going to fight?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not going to start anything with you. Believe me, it'd be too easy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now I'm going to go into the dance and comfort `my girlfriend.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now I'm going to go into the dance and comfort [color=#e23b3b][i]my girlfriend.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you're not going to follow.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Or else what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or else I do what an actual chaperone would do and have security haul you out for violence on school grounds.
Howard walks past Nate. Nate makes no move to stop him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I can ruin you! I know that you lied!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `'News flash'`... So does she.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'News flash'[/i][/color]... So does she.

nodes.text: Howard walks up to the doors. Through the glass, he can see $ZOE sitting on the steps of the haunted house with Owen.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What was I thinking? I spent so much time justifying why I belong here that I couldn't even be there for Zoe...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now it feels like I'm too late...
Howard punches Nate!
The blow makes Nate reel for a second...
Then he recovers, launching himself at Howard and pushing him back!
They burst through the doors of the gymnasium and straight into $ZOE's haunted house!
Nate and Howard barrel into a line of fake headstones and knock down the fake tree in the front!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! My house!
Nate and Howard roll in the fake dirt, taking down fake cobwebs and strings of scary lights.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm. Taking. You. `Down!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm. Taking. You. [color=#e23b3b][i]Down![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Never!
Nate and Howard tussle for several more minutes until they're both suddenly drenched with punch!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Ugh! What did you do?!
They both look up to see $ZOE with a now empty punch bowl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop it! Both of you!
Howard and Nate survey what they've done. The front yard of $ZOE's haunted house is a mess.
The tree has been completely uprooted, part of the house's facade has been ripped away, and the graveyard now lies in ruins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... It's ruined!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Zoe...
Howard stands up and puts an arm around her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm really sorry about what happened.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything that Ben and I built... It's all ruined!
$ZOE breaks away from Howard and runs towards the girls' restroom.
Howard glares at Nate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look what you've done!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I wasn't the only one rolling around in the graveyard, buddy.
At that moment, a police officer comes up to both of them.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You two! Stop right there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We weren't moving...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A likely story... You two are coming with me.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My father is the `mayor`--
nodes.text_bbcode: My father is the [color=#e23b3b][i]mayor[/i][/color]--

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Your father could be a pig, but I'm still hauling you down to the station. Come on.
As Monte leads Howard and Nate out of the gym, Howard feels his stomach sink, knowing he's let $ZOE down...
One thing's for sure...
Howard has failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE makes her own choices, and no amount of manipulation is going to make her like you any more.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: She might like me better if I told her that her boyfriend lied to her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You can't fool me. I know everything that's going on in this school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. Fine. What are you going to tell $ZOE I lied about?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That there is no Vernal Equinox! You're here because you couldn't take college life!
Howard stares at him, then starts laughing.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You don't think I'm serious?
Nate shoves Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You wanna go, man? I'll go! I could take you in a heartbeat!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You talk a big game... But you have `no` idea who you're messing with...
nodes.text_bbcode: You talk a big game... But you have [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color] idea who you're messing with...

nodes.text: Howard stares down Nate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I do. I'm dealing with a washed-up, washed-out college guy who's pathetically trying to cling to the glory of his high school days.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, news flash: those days are `over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, news flash: those days are [color=#e23b3b][i]over.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard is all at once filled with the overwhelming urge to punch Nate's face in.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE's a good girl.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And I want to protect her because she's my friend.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Bull. All you're interested in is getting rid of me, so that you can get to her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you're doing it wrong.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And it just rankles you that I used to be the football captain, and everyone likes me better.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're `jealous.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]jealous.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Jealous?! Of you? Yeah right!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Who is anyone going to remember more: the `popular` football captain or the guy who got them to the State Championships?
nodes.text_bbcode: Who is anyone going to remember more: the [color=#e23b3b][i]popular[/i][/color] football captain or the guy who got them to the State Championships?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then what do you want?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I want to protect $ZOE.
$ZOE walks back to her side to find that her haunted house is still empty.
Sam, Howard, and Ben are nowhere to be seen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not even my closest friends are here... What now?
$ZOE sits on top of a headstone, trying to keep from tearing up.
You are now playing as Howard.
In the school cafeteria, Howard helps Mr. Russell collect cups and supplies for the dance's snack table.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Thanks for helping, Howard. It's nice to see a different face around here. It's usually just the same old staff.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine, Mr. Russell.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Please, it's Melville. Or Mel.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine, Mel. I'm actually enjoying myself. I didn't know that Ms. Pliny almost took the same major as me when she was in college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or that you and Alicia's sister got married!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Funny how it's not until after high school that you realize teachers have lives outside the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: I admit, I was surprised to see you around again. Aren't you supposed to be at Kingston?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just on a break.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: That's good. You were always bright. When I heard you were majoring in the sciences, I was impressed.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: You'll be in an excellent position when you finish Kingston's program. It's the top rated in the country.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: But don't listen to me ramble on. Surely you must have something better to do then hang out back here on a Saturday night.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, my girlfriend's out there. I've been trying to see her all evening.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Ah. That must be it. I don't need you to set out more cups. You go out there and have fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's weird how I can talk with Mr. Russell like that. It's like we're equals or something...
Howard rushes towards the gym. Through the door's glass panel, he can see $ZOE sitting in front of her attraction, her head buried in her hands.
He is almost through the doors when...
Nate appears in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nate?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, I don't want to hassle you, but technically, students aren't supposed to be back here.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Neither are recent high school graduates, but here you are.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Here I am. Now can I get by?
Howard tries to step around, but Nate blocks his path.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you want, Nate?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: A faster car, a vacation house in Hawaii, and the chance to play football professionally...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But what I want the most is for you to disappear.
Howard stares Nate down before responding.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what it is you have against me, but I'm not the guy you should be trying to pick a fight with.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Am I? You're the all-star football player and seemingly good guy that swooped in to date the nicest girl in school...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Aren't you?
And then it clicks for Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I get what this is. You're taking your anger out on me because...

options.label: You hate being in my shadow.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, come on, look at your haunted house! You just threw it together at the last minute!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I may have put it together quickly, but I've made sure that people will enjoy it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's cute that you think that'll make a difference. Too bad no one will be there. They don't even need to go to your side to see how bad it is.
Paige points at some students who have already started filling out the ballot forms on computers near the attractions.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That doesn't prove anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes, it does. It proves that I'm going to win, and I just can't `wait` until the announcement ceremony.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, it does. It proves that I'm going to win, and I just can't [color=#3b78e2][i]wait[/i][/color] until the announcement ceremony.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll see what happens.
$ZOE strides away as confidently as she can.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This doesn't mean that Paige is going to win!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I hope.
She ducks into the nearest tent, so Paige won't see that she's upset.
Inside, $ZOE is greeted with the smell of strong incense and burning wax.
An older woman in robes sits at a table with a crystal ball and a stack of brightly painted cards in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Good evening. I am Madame Fortuna, the fortune teller.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh, sorry... I didn't mean to bother you!

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: You are not. I was expecting you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Please, have a seat.
$ZOE reluctantly sits down at the table.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: You are carrying a lot of worry with you. I sense there is trouble in your romantic and social life...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do you know?

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Because you are a teenager.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... That's not really a fortune...

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: No, merely an observation. But perhaps a reading will lend you some insight into how your future will develop...
Madame Fortuna takes her deck, shuffles it, and draws the first three cards off the top.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: These are the two cards that have responded to your spiritual energy.

nodes.speaker: Madame Fortuna
nodes.text: Choose one. It will tell you what your immediate future holds...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I choose the card...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I didn't think she meant this.
$ZOE can't hold it in any longer. Tears run down her face.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE...
He holds his arms out, and she steps into his embrace. They hold each other for a while, neither wanting to be the first to pull away.
And then the moment ends when the door to the gym bursts open, and Sam walks out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! You've got to get in here quick! They're announcing the Social Chair...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I think you've got a shot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll... I'll be there in a second!
Sam ducks back inside. $ZOE starts wiping the tears away from her cheeks and sniffles hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't look like a mess, do I?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You always look beautiful to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Are we... Are we ever going to see each other again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not for a while. But maybe someday.
Then he leans down and kisses her tenderly. She savors the moment as if it's their last kiss in the world...
Because somewhere deep in $ZOE's crumbling heart, she knows it is.
Howard pulls away, and they face each other for the last time.

options.label: I don't know what I'll do without you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Never mind... Come on, let's go to the haunted house and party it up!
You have reached the end of `The Halloween Dance, Part 2.`

Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Howard resists!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Patience and restraint are the marks of a wise man'... If there's anything I learned from fencing at Kingston, it's that punching Nate isn't going to do either of us good.
...But that doesn't stop Nate from talking.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You know, you don't even belong here. Even if $ZOE doesn't see what's going on, I do.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You two shouldn't even be together. You're keeping her from moving on and enjoying all the high school she has left.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You're just holding her back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not true. Our relationship is once-in-a-lifetime, and I'm not letting that go.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What relationship? You can't even be with her right now! You're back here, chatting it up with the teachers, getting cups!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right. Because you're not. Following her around like a puppy, spying on her, picking a fight with the guy she's dating...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's avoiding you. You're never going to win a girl like $ZOE.
Nate lunges forward to punch Howard!
Howard neatly steps around Nate, dodging the blow and causing Nate to charge straight into the lockers!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Unnhhh...
While Nate recovers, Howard sees the perfect opportunity to take him down...
Howard punches Nate!
The blow makes Nate reel for a second...
Then he recovers, launching himself at Howard and pushing him back!
They burst through the doors of the gymnasium and straight into $ZOE's haunted house!
Nate and Howard barrel into a line of fake headstones and knock down the fake tree in the front!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! My house!
Nate and Howard roll in the fake dirt, taking down fake cobwebs and strings of scary lights.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm. Taking. You. `Down!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm. Taking. You. [color=#e23b3b][i]Down![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Never!
Nate and Howard tussle for several more minutes until they're both suddenly drenched with punch!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Ugh! What did you do?!
They both look up to see $ZOE with a now empty punch bowl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Stop it! Both of you!
Howard and Nate survey what they've done. The front yard of $ZOE's haunted house is a mess.
The tree has been completely uprooted, part of the house's facade has been ripped away, and the graveyard now lies in ruins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... It's ruined!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Zoe...
Howard stands up and puts an arm around her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm really sorry about what happened.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything that Ben and I built... It's all ruined!
$ZOE breaks away from Howard and runs towards the girls' restroom.
Howard glares at Nate.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look what you've done!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I wasn't the only one rolling around in the graveyard, buddy.
At that moment, a police officer comes up to both of them.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You two! Stop right there!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We weren't moving...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A likely story... You two are coming with me.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: My father is the `mayor`--
nodes.text_bbcode: My father is the [color=#e23b3b][i]mayor[/i][/color]--

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Your father could be a pig, but I'm still hauling you down to the station. Come on.
As Monte leads Howard and Nate out of the gym, Howard feels his stomach sink, knowing he's let $ZOE down...
One thing's for sure...
Howard has failed.

nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You wanna go, man? I'll go! I could take you in a heartbeat!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You talk a big game... But you have `no` idea who you're messing with...
nodes.text_bbcode: You talk a big game... But you have [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color] idea who you're messing with...

nodes.text: Howard stares down Nate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I do. I'm dealing with a washed-up, washed-out college guy who's pathetically trying to cling to the glory of his high school days.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, news flash: those days are `over.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, news flash: those days are [color=#e23b3b][i]over.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard is all at once filled with the overwhelming urge to punch Nate's face in.
$ZOE walks back to her side to find that her haunted house is still empty.
Sam, Howard, and Ben are nowhere to be seen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not even my closest friends are here... What now?
$ZOE sits on top of a headstone, trying to keep from tearing up.
You are now playing as Howard.
In the school cafeteria, Howard helps Mr. Russell collect cups and supplies for the dance's snack table.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Thanks for helping, Howard. It's nice to see a different face around here. It's usually just the same old staff.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine, Mr. Russell.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Please, it's Melville. Or Mel.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's fine, Mel. I'm actually enjoying myself. I didn't know that Ms. Pliny almost took the same major as me when she was in college.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or that you and Alicia's sister got married!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Funny how it's not until after high school that you realize teachers have lives outside the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: I admit, I was surprised to see you around again. Aren't you supposed to be at Kingston?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just on a break.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: That's good. You were always bright. When I heard you were majoring in the sciences, I was impressed.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: You'll be in an excellent position when you finish Kingston's program. It's the top rated in the country.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: But don't listen to me ramble on. Surely you must have something better to do then hang out back here on a Saturday night.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, my girlfriend's out there. I've been trying to see her all evening.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Ah. That must be it. I don't need you to set out more cups. You go out there and have fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's weird how I can talk with Mr. Russell like that. It's like we're equals or something...
Howard rushes towards the gym. Through the door's glass panel, he can see $ZOE sitting in front of her attraction, her head buried in her hands.
He is almost through the doors when...
Nate appears in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nate?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Listen, I don't want to hassle you, but technically, students aren't supposed to be back here.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Neither are recent high school graduates, but here you are.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Here I am. Now can I get by?
Howard tries to step around, but Nate blocks his path.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you want, Nate?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: A faster car, a vacation house in Hawaii, and the chance to play football professionally...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But what I want the most is for you to disappear.
Howard stares Nate down before responding.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know what it is you have against me, but I'm not the guy you should be trying to pick a fight with.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Am I? You're the all-star football player and seemingly good guy that swooped in to date the nicest girl in school...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Aren't you?
And then it clicks for Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I get what this is. You're taking your anger out on me because...

A while later, $ZOE wanders out of her haunted house.
Hey, $ZOE, where are you going?
I'm going to look for Owen. He dropped by earlier to talk to me, and I wanted to thank him.
All right. Have fun!
Of course!
$ZOE wanders into the hallway and sees Owen standing near a locker.
Hey--
She stops when she realizes he and Paige are talking. She ducks behind a corner.
What are you doing? Shouldn't you be out there celebrating or something?
I saw you come out here... I thought I should check on you.
I don't need your help.
...Right. So I'm just going to stand right here. Think of it as my job.
I thought your job was shining shoes or whatever.
Owen laughs.
Who polishes shoes these days?
Servants who have taste...
Which, come to think of it, means that `you` wouldn't be shining shoes.
There she is. The Paige we've all come to know and tolerate.
He playfully nudges her, and Paige flashes him a brief smile.
Hey, you want to get out and grab a coffee or something?
At some point, we should probably talk about... Well, you know, about `what happened` between us.
Don't you have a carnival to run?
Eh. I lost. I don't care anymore.
Owen looks wistfully at the doors leading back into the gym.
Hey, I get it. I know where you really want to be. Forget it.
She strides away towards the exit, and Owen follows her.
Wait up... I'll walk you to your car.
$ZOE presses herself deeper into the shadow of the lockers as they pass by her.
Owen... and Paige? I wonder what happened between them...
Looks like $ZOE's not the only girl in Owen's life anymore! How will she handle it?
Find out in the next season of Surviving High School!
And how did the other students enjoy the Halloween Dance? Let's check!
Owen... You have come to me in a state of confusion.
Well, kind of. I was actually looking for the restrooms...
And you arrived here. How am I wrong? Sit.
Okay.
Owen... There are big changes coming in your life. I see you before a crossroads, making a difficult decision. You must choose a path.
Which one?
The spirits warn you... They say you must `go left.`
Go left? Go left where?
It is not for me to see that. Remember their words.
So... Can I go now?
Poor soul... Nick, you are still troubled by the loss of a loved one.
Yes, I am. It's been... It's been hard.
But do not worry. You will be absolved, and the hardships you bear will lighten.
For now, do what you love, and love will come back to you.
I hope so.
Colt and Denni. A lovely pair. For you two... I see a sunset in your future...
A sunset's good isn't it?
No... In fact, doesn't a 'sunset' mean an end?
Okay, that doesn't sound good.
It's natural to be afraid or wary of a big change, but I also see a rising star for both of you.
You will be given the opportunity to rise again.
Awesome.
I confess, I'm a little skeptical about all of this. It's all a little vague.
Believe what you like. I know my fortunes will make sense in time.
Kimi... You have much ambition.
Ambition? Or an enthusiasm for popularity?
Whatever it is you call it... You have much of it, but it is tempered by a lack of direction.
This is about the after-school activities, huh? I swear, taking violin wouldn't have done me much in the long run.
So what's going to happen to me?
The spirits tell me that you should not worry. Your time in the spotlight will come...
Wes, welcome to my tent. I know you. You are clever and smart and can move those around you in ways they cannot even see...
You've got an accurate gauge so far.
The thing is... I know all about you... Madame Fortuna. Or should I say Myrtle Kazlowski?
Your cold readings are good enough to fool the chumps. But you're no psychic. So how'd you do it? Who's your `in` at the school?
My only `in` is the power I've been cursed with...
I said, you can drop the act--
Wes, my prediction for you is that you'll play a very important role later on... You will be the key to unraveling the entire mystery.
And you will do it out of love.
I'm not really looking for a girlfriend. It's easier to be unattached... But I look forward to seeing it come true. `If` it does.
Samantha... I see in your future a promising and blossoming romance this spring...
Now I `know` you're a fake... If you knew anything about my love life, you'd know there's nothing lucky there.
Do not take my words so lightly, dear. You have suffered, but the spirits beyond have something bright in store for you.
I'm going to need something more specific...
Sam swears she can see Madame Fortuna roll her eyes, but the fortune teller starts speaking.
I see a Friday between February 8 to 15. You will find a spark, and your life will change.
Uh, okay... I'll mark that down on my calendar.
Ben and Emily, welcome to Madame Fortuna's. What is it that you would like to know?
Ben and Emily exchange glances.
I think we want a general fortune about our future. As a couple.
Whoa, are you sure you want to know? What if she tells us that we're not meant to be together?
Then I suppose I'll have to leave you for someone else.
Aww...
Madame Fortuna sets out her cards and draws two of them out of the pile. Ben picks one, and the fortune teller turns it over to reveal a large boulder.
You are very compatible according to the cards, but there are things that stand in the way of you two being truly happy.
What are they?
I do not know the specifics, but the only way to remedy what ails your relationship acceptance of both yourself and each other.
Without full acceptance of one another, your relationship will suffer and end.
The fortune brings a pall to the room, and Ben and Emily uneasily slip outside the tent.
Do you think what she said will come true?
It wasn't really that specific. She just stated that we have to be honest and accepting of each other.
Haven't we been?
Ben thinks of all the times he and Emily have ever fought, and he suddenly thinks about everything related to Cameron.
No. And that's my fault. Madame Fortuna said that without full acceptance, our relationship will end.
I haven't been completely upfront about how I feel about Cameron.
I don't really like him, but if you trust him and he wants to protect you, then I guess hearing stories about him and talking to him sometimes is okay.
Really?
But don't expect that I won't make fun of him to his face.
Really? So Madame Fortuna actually changed your mind?
Yeah... Well, that and I can see Cameron making out with Jane by the Cursed Mummy Tomb.
Oh--
Emily turns to look.
--Oh!
Yep, and he just totally flashed me a thumbs up. Keep up the good work, buddy!
Emily kisses Ben on the cheek.
You're the best! Now can we go?
This is kind of like watching my older brother get his tonsils examined.
Emily takes Ben's hand and pulls him into the fake cemetery for a dance.
And that's your bonus scene!
